title: Parts Returns tab shows Vendor, Category and Part Type filters
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Parts pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Parts area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Parts area and go to the Returns page.
2. Make sure the Returns tab is selected (the page has Returns and Credits tabs).
3. Look at the filter buttons shown above the returns table.
expected: 1. The Returns tab shows three filter buttons: Vendor, Category and Part Type.
2. The table shows the columns: Work Order, Vendor Invoice, Vendor, Part Number, Description, Quantity, Cost, Total Cost, Return Reason, Status and Requested.
3. A blue Create Return button is shown at the top right.
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11884-16885 (Parts filters); design-notes.md §B.5 #4
notes: Design-only (chip + column presence). Option lists and apply behaviour pending Branko's PRD.
